Durham's Inspiring Excellence Scholarships are merit awards for international students applying to taught master's programmes. Awards are considered alongside your course application, so the practical deadline is the admission round of your chosen programme, with values and eligibility listed on Durham's scholarships page.

Programme Highlights

  • Merit-based partial fee awards across Durham's faculties
  • No separate form in most cases — assessed with admission
  • Programme-level deadlines rather than one central date
  • Strengthens the UK postgraduate offer for self-funding students

Who Should Apply

International applicants holding offers for Durham taught master's programmes with strong academic records.

Funding and Costs

Partial tuition-fee awards for international taught-postgraduate applicants, values listed per programme. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Check the scholarship page for your programme's award and apply for admission in good time; any separate steps are listed there. Key deadline information: Considered with your course application — deadlines follow each programme's admission round.

Official Source

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Durham University

Durham University is a collegiate public research university in northeast England and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across science, business, humanities and social sciences. Its colleges and departments support study and research, connecting disciplinary scholarship with international collaboration and broader societal questions.

Official website: https://www.durham.ac.uk

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: With course application - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
